---

### BootRunClaims

```ts
type BootRunClaims = Readonly<{
  acquire: (input) => Promise<BootRunClaim>;
  finish: (input) => Promise<void>;
}>;
```

The run slot for one key, in a store every isolate shares (the Hub's catalog
D1). `acquire` is one atomic step: it hands the slot to exactly one asker unless
a live claim exists, and a claim past its lease is free, so a crashed holder
never blocks the Release.

---

```ts
type SingleFlightBootInput = BootRunKey &

    record: (outcome) => Promise<UiBootCheckOutcome>;
    now: () => number;
    sleep: (ms) => Promise<void>;
    newClaimId: () => string;
    leaseMs: number;
    pollMs: number;
    coolMs: number;
    maxWaitMs: number;
  }>;
```

Everything one single-flight boot ask needs.

## Functions

### singleFlightBoot()

```ts
function singleFlightBoot(input): Promise<
  | {
      kind: "passed";
    }
  | {
      kind: "failed";
      code: "ui_mount_failed";
      diagnostics?: {
        failedPredicate:
          | "unexpected_candidate_request"
          | "response_status"
          | "request_failed"
          | "page_error"
          | "candidate_not_mounted";
        errorName?:
          | "Error"
          | "TypeError"
          | "RangeError"
          | "SyntaxError"
          | "AbortError"
          | "TimeoutError"
          | "Other";
        finalUrlPath: string;
        consoleErrors: string[];
        pageErrors: string[];
        failedRequests: object[];
        droppedCount: number;
      };
    }
  | {
      kind: "not_checked";
      code:
        | "boot_runner_unavailable"
        | "boot_browser_binding_missing"
        | "boot_clone_unavailable"
        | "boot_timeout"
        | "boot_cleanup_failed"
        | "ui_check_not_run_on_host";
    }
>;
```

At most one boot check per Release and check version is in flight across every
caller sharing `claims`. A definitive outcome is recorded and read by everyone
after. A waiter reuses whatever the holder produced: the recorded verdict, or
its inconclusive reason for `coolMs`. An inconclusive outcome is never a verdict
and never reported as a pass; once the cooldown ends the next ask checks again.
